sn14.19:1.1: Pañca || || Aṭṭhamaṃ || || Sāvatthi || || I Dhātuso || pe|| || Ahirikā ahirikehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti || anottāpino anottapīhi saddhiṃ || duppaññā duppaññehi saddhiṃ || || Hirimanā hirimanehi saddhiṃ || ottāpino ottāpīhi saddhiṃ || paññavanto paññavantehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samentīti || || Atītam pi || Anāgatam pi || Paccuppannam addhānaṃ- samentīti || || Ekaṃ || || II Ahirikā
sn14.19:2.1: ahirikehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti || appassutā appassutehi saddhimo || duppaññā duppaññehi saddhimo || || Hirimanā hirimanehi saddhiṃ- || bahussutā bahussutehi saddhiṃ- paññavanto paññavantehi saddhim saṃsandanti samenti || || Dve || || III
sn14.19:3.1: Ahirikā ahirikehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti || kusītā kusītehi saddhiṃ || duppaññā duppaññehi saddhiṃ- || || Hirimanā hirimanehi saddhiṃ- || āraddhaviriyā āraddhaviriyehi saddhiṃ- || paññavanto paññavantehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samentīti || Tīṇi || || IV
